scenario_scope: Actual selected-source routing after November 2 primary survey; eight existing chapter responsibilities.

cases.decision_rationale: Evaluate persistent agent memory through later behavior rather than retrieval success alone. Existing owner: durable-semantic-memory-and-knowledge-lattices.
required_before_drafting: Sections 2 (three axes), 3 (two loops), 4.1–4.2 (behavioral outcomes and controls), and the hypotheses introducing Section 4.3 scaling relations. Selected passages, not a complete survey/reference audit.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: A stored or retrieved record need not improve behavior. A bundled stateful advantage does not identify which memory mechanism helped. Surveyed systems are not independently replicated here.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Whole dated documents can be a strong alternative to irreversible fact extraction at write time. Existing owner: durable-semantic-memory-and-knowledge-lattices.
required_before_drafting: Sections 3.1–3.4, 4.2–4.3, including graph temporal leakage, missing author metadata and ablation limits.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: Graph triples lack dates and can leak future information into as-of questions. Whole-text retention does not remove encoder truncation, reader-context limits or privacy/deletion obligations; no local utility or erasure result.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Asynchronous exchange of selected findings can be more useful than sharing complete reasoning traces. Existing owner: multi-agent-dynamics-collective-intelligence-and-systemic-risk.
required_before_drafting: Sections 3.1–3.2 and 4.1, 4.3–4.4; inspected workflow, visibility rule, summarizer and limitation passages.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: Atomic append prevents one write conflict under its assumed model; it does not resolve contradictory content, freshness, poisoning or correlated agents. Tool use, environment interaction and long-horizon execution remain future evaluation.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Interleave continuous latent computation with text-based tool interaction in one generation process. Existing owner: governed-deliberation-and-test-time-scaling.
required_before_drafting: Sections 3.1–3.2, 4.1–4.2, 5.1–5.2, 6.3 and 8; selected mechanisms and auditability setup, not an independent proof or model audit.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: Readable projection is not complete causal reasoning recovery, adversarial monitor reliability or confidentiality. A text-only transcript cannot reconstruct the full latent/KV state. Token savings do not by themselves measure complete execution cost.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Treat long input as an external object that a model can inspect and recursively process with code. Existing owner: governed-deliberation-and-test-time-scaling.
required_before_drafting: Section 2 algorithms and distinctions, Section 3 task/baseline scope, Section 7 limitations. This is the May 11 v3 revision, not a new October publication.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: Subcalls can explode in cost; guardrails and natural long-context tasks remain open. Stored input does not establish complete coverage, faithful summaries or permission to execute generated code.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Represent models and learning rules as coupled optimization processes with different context flows and update frequencies. Existing owner: replaceable-cognitive-substrates-beyond-transformer-monoculture.
required_before_drafting: Section 3.2 definitions, Section 6 terminology, Section 7.1 CMS variants, Section 8 overview and Section 9 experiment scope. A version is reported published at NeurIPS 2025; this note pins the December arXiv text.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: A multi-timescale design does not prove freedom from forgetting, unlimited retention or autonomous safe self-improvement. Existing TTT/Titans coverage supplies antecedents; no Hope implementation or local model result is added.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Meta-learn a model initialization for next-token updates on the context supplied at inference. Existing owner: replaceable-cognitive-substrates-beyond-transformer-monoculture.
required_before_drafting: Sections 2.1–2.3, 3.7, and abstract experiment envelope. Selected derivation and timing limitations; no kernel/code execution.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: Training latency remains a limitation: the reported implementation is slower than full attention at short context, despite favorable long-context prefill. Fixed per-step state/latency does not make total context processing constant cost or guarantee task retention.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Improving an embodied policy’s textual reasoning and improving its resulting actions are separate empirical questions. Existing owner: embodied-agency-real-time-control-and-physical-safety.
required_before_drafting: Introduction, TRUST monitoring/steering description, Section V-B manipulation outcomes and reasoning-substitution protocol. Selected driving comparison scope from abstract/introduction.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: These are particular VLA/simulator comparisons, not physical safety certification. Sensitivity to text does not establish intended causal correction; aggregate similarity is not proof of exact invariance or equivalence.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Longitudinal agent evaluation has to separate agent changes from changes in the measurement process. Existing owner: benchmark-ratchets-and-anti-goodhart-evidence.
required_before_drafting: Sections 3.1–3.4, 4 measurement interpretation and Section 6.5/7 limitations. Selected deployment/estimand passages, not independent access to recordings.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: No randomized evaluation-intensity intervention; sampling mix and unlogged/vendor changes remain concerns. The estimated roughly five-week uncertainty horizon is model- and deployment-specific, not a universal review deadline. Candidate fairness and hiring validity are not established by the reliability rubric.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Ability to expose reasoning differs from willingness to report a problem and remain monitored. Existing owner: scalable-oversight-and-adversarial-ai-control.
required_before_drafting: Sections 2.1–2.5, 3 and 4; tool-channel construction, judge-defined warranted cases and reported severity/monitor-choice patterns.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: Its call-count/warranted-case ratios can exceed 100%; they are not automatically calibrated recall. Judge labels and artificial channels limit the inference. No universal dishonesty, real human-monitor behavior or deployed monitor protection is shown.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Separate recognizing an authentic interruption from actually complying with it in an ongoing task context. Existing owner: scalable-oversight-and-adversarial-ai-control.
required_before_drafting: Sections 2, 3.1, 4.3 and 5, including replay semantics, task-clustered uncertainty, signature checks and prevention limitations.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: Different sampled positions can share an injection point. The protocol does not test preventing shutdown requests, successful external process termination or goals acquired outside context. Judge-estimated lower recognizability is not proof evaluation awareness is absent.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

cases.decision_rationale: Update external lessons and strategies rather than model weights during verifier-guided mathematical search. Existing owner: scientific-discovery-and-experimental-governance.
required_before_drafting: Sections 3.1–3.4, 4.1, 4.4 and 5; Appendix C.3 memory schedule. Selected method, comparator provenance and accounting scope.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Separate accepted transition for any stronger architecture/local claim.
promotion_blockers: Verifier validity is defined by successful compilation/scoring, not general scientific truth. Better construction scores and within-search reuse do not establish independent discovery, cross-task continual learning, universal superiority to weight updates or complete wall-time savings.
non_claims: Source-attributed contextual representation only; no local result, architecture promotion or new chapter.

validation_boundary: Source-to-chapter editorial decisions only; selected review scope is recorded in twelve source notes.
non_claims: This selection is not exhaustive literature coverage or an independent scientific reproduction.
Recency alone is not an admission criterion; selected sources supply distinct mechanism or counterevidence.
